oracle.explanation: This oracle validates the boundary-prediction vulnerability by controlling Math.random deterministically. It first performs a benign multipart operation and confirms normal serialization, then predicts the exact boundary the next FormData instance will generate under vulnerable logic (24 Math.random-derived hex digits). It injects that predicted boundary into attacker-controlled field content and marks exploitation successful only when: (1) generated boundary matches prediction and (2) forged multipart content markers are present in the serialized body. In patched versions using cryptographic randomness, boundary prediction fails, so exploit_succeeded becomes false while operation_completed remains true.
